description: Remove ALL research questions from every file, install lenis for smooth scrolling, and set up the new branch baseline. This includes removing RQ content from all 10 public/data/*.json files, removing the research-questions overlay from index.html, removing methodology section references to RQs, removing RQ references from src/overlay-ui.js, src/species-page.js, and scripts/fetch-tmdb-data.js. Also install lenis package.
steps: Run npm install lenis in /projects/sandbox/species-on-screen to add smooth scrolling library

Edit all 10 files in public/data/*.json: remove the 'research_questions' array field entirely from each file. Also remove or redact the 'methodology_notes' field (it references RQ1-RQ4 explicitly). Keep all other fields intact.

Edit index.html: remove the entire overlay--research section (the div containing 'Research Framework' heading and all RQ1-RQ4 content). Also remove the overlay--methodology section entirely (it references the research framework).
Edit src/overlay-ui.js: remove the 'research' and 'methodology' entries from OVERLAY_RANGES and remove caching of overlay--research and overlay--methodology elements

Edit src/species-page.js: remove the renderMethodology function entirely (it renders research questions). Remove the call to renderMethodology(data) from renderSpeciesPage. Also remove the RQ2 reference in the renderOnScreen intro paragraph.

Edit scripts/fetch-tmdb-data.js: remove the RESEARCH_QUESTIONS constant array and any code that writes research_questions into the output JSON files. Remove methodology_notes from the species data objects.
Edit src/species-page.css: remove the .sp-methodology__rqs, .sp-methodology__rq-list, and related styles (they will never render now)
Run npm run build to verify the project still builds cleanly after these changes
acceptance_criteria: No file in the repository contains the text 'RQ1', 'RQ2', 'RQ3', or 'RQ4'
No file contains the text 'research_questions' or 'Research Framework'
No file contains the specific RQ text about 'digital content helping enhance awareness'
npm run build succeeds without errors
lenis package is listed in package.json dependencies
verification: Run: grep -r 'RQ1\|RQ2\|RQ3\|RQ4\|research_questions\|Research Framework' --include='*.js' --include='*.json' --include='*.html' --include='*.css' /projects/sandbox/species-on-screen/src /projects/sandbox/species-on-screen/public /projects/sandbox/species-on-screen/species /projects/sandbox/species-on-screen/scripts /projects/sandbox/species-on-screen/index.html -- should return nothing
Run: npm run build in /projects/sandbox/species-on-screen -- should exit 0
findings: All research question references (RQ1-RQ4, research_questions, Research Framework, methodology_notes) successfully removed from all source files. Lenis installed as dependency (^1.3.23). Build passes cleanly. Also updated screen reader description in index.html to reflect the removed sections.
